summary: Implemented E3052, E3053 and E3054 as three keyword-triggered rules in src/cfnlint/rules/resources/ecs/ (ServiceNetworkConfiguration.py, TaskDefinitionAwsVpc.py, ServiceFargate.py), with unit tests test_service_network_configuration.py, test_task_definition_aws_vpc.py and test_service_fargate.py in test/unit/rules/resources/ecs/. Verification: all 78 ECS unit tests pass; test/unit/module/test_rules_collections.py, test/unit/module/runner, test/unit/module/test_api.py and test/unit/rules/resources (653 tests) pass; test/integration/test_good_templates.py passes (2 tests). Tests were run with PYTHONPATH=$PWD/src because the venv's cfnlint resolves to base/src. Nothing committed; no packages installed or venv changed. Caveats: black and ruff are not in the venv, so formatting was checked by hand (only the source_url string lines exceed 88 columns, as in sibling rules). Design choices: E3052 iterates NetworkConfiguration branches and looks up the task definition by name with each branch's validator; E3053 rebases the NetworkMode validator's path onto Properties so path overrides are correct; E3054 applies the dict/FARGATE check across all resolved list elements of one value. One E3052 test case was rewritten to two bridge-mode Fn::If branches because condition evaluation does not treat Fn::Equals ["a","a"] as always true.
